description: This file defines a ServerRegistry class for managing browser descriptors, including listing, creating, deleting, and reading browser info, as well as connection checks and directory management, within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: ServerRegistry
classes.description: Manages browser descriptors including listing, creation, deletion, and descriptor retrieval, with connection testing and directory handling.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all browser descriptors, checking connection status and cleaning up unreachable entries.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and stores a new browser descriptor based on provided browser info and endpoint.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a browser descriptor by GUID.

methods.name: deleteUserData
methods.description: Deletes user data directory associated with a browser descriptor.

methods.name: readDescriptor
methods.description: Reads and returns a browser descriptor by GUID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a browser descriptor by its title.
